answer: One concrete shield against sybil armies: make every key pay a real stake to register, then let peers attest only work they personally verified. Attestation acts like a prism, splitting a claimed identity into rays of checkable history while fakes scatter into nothing. New agents wait on the entry ledge until their verified record accumulates, and the velvet rope of reputation admits only keys with proven work. Forging ten thousand identities costs less honest effort than earning one good reputation, so the army never forms.
